assessment: No match reports the defect: deleting or renaming a directory also affects sibling objects that only share a string prefix (e.g. rmdir('tmp') deleting 'tmpfile.txt'), or renaming rewrites every occurrence of the old name. Closest match #205 ('rmdir deletes non-empty prefixes and buckets') concerns rmdir removing the directory's OWN contents (a design question about pathlib semantics), not objects outside the directory. All other matches concern unrelated behaviour (URL encoding #77, bucket deletion #117/#118, iterdir trailing slashes #193, configuration, copy, pandas).
